title: ColibriTD Raises €4 Million ($4.66 Million USD) Seed Round to Scale Multiphysics Quantum Simulation Software - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Paris-based ColibriTD closed a €4M ($4.66M) Seed round led by Earlybird Venture Capital (with SymbiaVC and Medin VC) to scale its H-DES hybrid quantum PDE-solver software, which is already IBM Qiskit Function Catalog-listed and has completed seven paid industrial co-construction projects across six verticals.

insights.claim: ColibriTD raised a €4 million ($4.66 million USD) Seed round led by Earlybird Venture Capital, with participation from SymbiaVC and Medin VC, following Earlybird's earlier €1 million pre-seed check.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Earlybird doubling down from pre-seed to lead Seed signals investor conviction in the quantum-simulation-software niche (vs. hardware) and a de-risked bet given prior diligence relationship.
insights.quote: ColibriTD has closed a €4 million ($4.66 million USD) Seed funding round led by Earlybird Venture Capital, with participation from SymbiaVC and Medin VC.

insights.claim: The Seed capital is earmarked specifically for algorithm-stack R&D, international expansion, and scaling the 20-person Paris team with quantum physicists and application engineers, rather than hardware capex.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A software-only (no proprietary QPU) capital allocation implies lower burn per dollar raised and a services/licensing-oriented path to revenue versus capital-intensive quantum hardware plays.
insights.quote: R&D Acceleration: Expanding core research into H-DES algorithm efficiency, error mitigation routines, and multiphysics integration.

insights.claim: ColibriTD's flagship H-DES (Hybrid Differential Equation Solver) uses variational quantum algorithms to resolve high-dimensional PDEs that the company says exceed both classical approximation and statistical AI pattern-recognition capabilities.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Positions quantum PDE-solving as a distinct value proposition from the AI/ML wave rather than a competitor to it, potentially opening a defensible niche in physics simulation software.
insights.quote: H-DES Core Engine: The company’s flagship technology, the Hybrid Differential Equation Solver (H-DES), uses variational quantum algorithms to resolve high-dimensional PDEs that exceed classical approximation capabilities or statistical AI pattern recognition.
insights.locator: H-DES Algorithm and Partial Differential Equation Focus

insights.claim: IBM has listed ColibriTD's QUICK-PDE function in its official Qiskit Function Catalog, giving IBM Quantum Premium and Flex Plan customers direct access to ColibriTD's PDE solver inside classical-quantum workflows.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Distribution through IBM's paid enterprise quantum channel is a concrete go-to-market validation and revenue funnel that de-risks the software's commercial path independent of the Seed raise.
insights.quote: IBM has listed ColibriTD’s QUICK-PDE Qiskit Function within the official Qiskit Function Catalog, allowing IBM Quantum Premium and Flex Plan users to execute PDE solvers directly within classical-quantum workflows.
insights.locator: H-DES Algorithm and Partial Differential Equation Focus

insights.claim: ColibriTD has already completed seven industrial co-construction projects across six verticals, including radio frequency design, propulsion combustion modeling, climate modeling, chip design, nuclear physics, and financial risk assessment.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Pre-Seed-stage paid pilots across defense, semiconductors, and finance suggest a horizontal enterprise-simulation platform rather than a single-vertical bet, broadening the addressable market.
insights.quote: ColibriTD has completed seven industrial co-construction projects across six verticals—including radio frequency design, combustion modeling for propulsion systems, climate modeling, chip design, nuclear physics, and financial risk assessment.
insights.locator: H-DES Algorithm and Partial Differential Equation Focus

insights.claim: ColibriTD's software is hardware-agnostic, running across IBM Quantum (Qiskit), AWS Braket, and IQM, IonQ, and Quobly QPUs, with plans to expand compatibility further.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A hardware-agnostic middleware position lets ColibriTD ride whichever QPU vendor wins the near-term error-correction race, reducing platform risk relative to single-hardware-stack startups.
insights.quote: Ecosystem & Partner Expansion: Expanding hardware compatibility beyond IBM, AWS Braket, IQM, IonQ, and Quobly, while establishing new industrial partnerships across Europe and North America.
